programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi ii sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara, koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstvom.

programme.title: Dženino venčanje
programme.desc: U gradiću u kom je rođena, niko ne shvata zašto se Dženi, najlepša i najpopularnija devojka iz kraja, još uvek nije udala. Kruže glasine da je ljubavnica oženjenog muškarca u "velikom gradu" u kom sada živi, zbog čega nikoga ne dovodi sa sobom na venčanje svog školskog druga. Njeni roditelji očajnički žele da se skrasi. Ipak, Dženina objava venčanja, kada do toga konačno dođe, nije ono što je bilo ko od njih očekivao.

programme.title: Veliki medved
programme.desc: "Big Bear" je priča o Džou, koji nevoljno odlazi na svoje momačko veče iako ga je verenica upravo ostavila zbog nekog tipa.

programme.title: Dobri komšija
programme.desc: Dvojica nestašnih srednjoškolaca uspešno uveravaju svog vremešnog komšiju da u njegovoj kući ima duhova. Međutim, niz nesrećnih okolnosti pretvara njihovu bezazlenu šalu u tragediju.

programme.title: Seven Chances
programme.desc: A man learns he will inherit a fortune if he marries by 7 p.m. that same day.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Imprisoned for a murder he did not commit, John Brant escapes and ends up out west where, after giving the local lawmen the slip, he joins up with an outlaw gang. Brant finds out that 'Jones', one of the outlaws he has become friends with, committed the murder that Brant was sent up for, but has no knowledge that anyone was ever put in jail for his crime. Willing to forgive and forget, Brant doesn't realize that "Jones" has not only fallen for the same pretty shopgirl Brant has, but begins to suspect that Brant is not truly an outlaw.

programme.title: Too Late for Tears
programme.desc: Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.

programme.title: The Stranger Within a Woman
programme.desc: Two friends meet in a bar. Later that night, one friend's flirtatious wife is reportedly in an accident. The other friend doesn't feel well. What's come over him?

programme.title: The River
programme.desc: An introvert city teenager is sent to his father's limber ranch. While trying to figure out his place as the son of the boss he finds himself in a world packed with naturalized violence.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: Due to a possible cholera epidemic onboard, passengers on a ship are forced to disembark at Pago Pago, a small village on a Pacific island where it incessantly rains. Among the stranded passengers are Sadie Thompson, a prostitute, and Alfred Davidson, a fanatic missionary who will try to redeem her.

programme.title: Sunny
programme.desc: The beautiful Anna Neagle stars as a circus performer who falls in love with a rich car dealer's son, against her family's wishes. Features some spirited dance numbers with Ray Bolger.

programme.title: The Man of the Eiffel Tower
programme.desc: French police inspector Maigret investigates the murder of a rich Paris widow and ends up chasing the killer up the Eiffel Tower's girders.

programme.title: Frieda
programme.desc: A Royal Air Force pilot who was shot down during World War II returns home to his English village with his new bride. The trouble is that she is the German lady who helped him escape. Then her brother arrives.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: Seven guests, a newly hired personal secretary and two staff are gathered for a weekend on an isolated island by the hosts the Owens who are delayed. At dinner a record is played and the host's message alleges that all the people present are guilty of murder and suddenly the first of them is dead, then the next _ It seems that one of them is the murderer but the leading person is always the person who is murdered next and at last only two people are left.

programme.title: Made for Each Other
programme.desc: While on a business trip, an ambitious young lawyer meets and immediately falls in love with a stranger. They wed the following day, and tragedy soon strikes.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

programme.title: Quality Time
programme.desc: Five thirty-something men in as many separate segments struggle to grapple with the relentless absurdity of their respective existences.

programme.title: Vigilantes
programme.desc: Young Mary settles in a town to follow theater courses. Just after her arrival, she is sexually assaulted. The next day she meets Eve, a non-conformist young woman with frayed nerves, who drags her along in a nocturnal and violent maze. For the space of one night, they become Les Vigilantes.

programme.title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
programme.desc: An American boy turns out to be the long-lost heir of a British fortune. He is sent to live with the cold and unsentimental lord who oversees the trust.

programme.title: The Inspector General
programme.desc: An illiterate stooge in a traveling medicine show wanders into a strange town and is picked up on a vagrancy charge. The town's corrupt officials mistake him for the inspector general whom they think is traveling in disguise. Fearing he will discover they've been pocketing tax money, they make several bungled attempts to kill him.

programme.title: The Inspector General
programme.desc: An illiterate stooge in a traveling medicine show wanders into a strange town and is picked up on a vagrancy charge. The town's corrupt officials mistake him for the inspector general whom they think is traveling in disguise. Fearing he will discover they've been pocketing tax money, they make several bungled attempts to kill him.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: Answer Me
programme.desc: The love story of a couple which, after the marriage and the birth of the first son, turns into hell. Taken from the novel Rispondimi by Susanna Tamaro.

programme.title: Brides
programme.desc: Nutsa lives with her two small children in suburb of Tblissi, Georgia. With her Goga, they would bee today a regular family if he hadn't been arrested. Between the wedding in prison and the monthly visits, a routine sets in. Wil they be able to overcome this double reality?

programme.title: Go for Broke!
programme.desc: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical step down memory lane, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey play themselves in this vehicle for their excellent music.

programme.title: The Overlanders
programme.desc: It's the start of WWII in Northern Australia. The Japanese are getting close. People are evacuating and burning everything in a "scorched earth" policy. Rather than kill all their cattle, a disparate group decides to drive them overland half way across the continent, from Wyndham in Western Australia through the Northern Territory outback of Australia to pastures north of Brisbane, Queensland.

programme.title: Roaring Abyss
programme.desc: A sound journey accros the mountains, deserts and forests of Ethiopia and its cultural universe. Roaring Abyss will take you through an inedit collection of music recordings of unvaluable importance for the transmission and preservation of the African heritage.

programme.title: The Big Wheel
programme.desc: A brash young midget car race driver lives in the shadow of his famous father, a drunken womanizer, who was killed in an accident years earlier.

programme.title: Outpost in Morocco
programme.desc: Captain Gerard, greatest lover in the Foreign Legion, is assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and find out what he can about the emir's activities. Gerard enjoys his work with lovely Cara, but arrives to find rebellion brewing.

programme.title: Delightfully Dangerous
programme.desc: Young Sherry Williams dreams of having a singing career, and she idolizes her older sister Josephine, who has gone to New York to perform on the stage. When Sherry is distraught just before performing at her school, a visiting Broadway producer encourages her by telling her positive things about her sister. Soon afterwards, Sherry decides to make a surprise trip to New York to visit Josephine _ but what she finds there is not at all what she expected.

programme.title: My Favourite Brunette
programme.desc: Ronnie Jackson is a lowly baby photographer who secretly fantasizes about being a private detective. When a lovely baroness actually mistakes him for one and asks him to help locate her missing husband, Baron Montay, Ronnie finds himself agreeing. Several days later he is on death row whiling away the hours until his execution by recounting to a group of reporters the bizarre tale of how he ended up there.

programme.title: Pot o' Gold
programme.desc: Jimmy goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band who constantly practices.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's a bloodthirsty plant, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: The Sadist
programme.desc: Three people driving into Los Angeles for a Dodgers game have car trouble and pull off into an old wrecking yard where they are held at bay by a bloodthirsty psycho and his crazy girlfriend.

programme.title: Au service du diable
programme.desc: A group of tourists traveling on a bus take a detour to stay overnight in a castle owned by a family cursed with a history of Satanism and death.

programme.title: Au service du diable
programme.desc: A group of tourists traveling on a bus take a detour to stay overnight in a castle owned by a family cursed with a history of Satanism and death.

programme.title: Mad Doctor of Blood Island
programme.desc: A man who loves to travel, travels to an island where a mad doctor is creating zombies.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A widow deceives her late husband's mother and brothers into thinking he's still alive when she attends the yearly memorial to his drowned sister, hoping to secure his inheritance, but her cunning is no match for the demented, axe-wielding thing roaming the grounds of the family's Irish estate.

programme.title: Doctor Blood's Coffin
programme.desc: Greta is a beautiful young woman abused by her brother Franz and left to die in childbirth by her illicit lover, the aristocrat Dr. von Ravensbrück. Bereft with grief, Franz reanimates his dead sister using a formula engraved on an ancient Incan medallion. Greta then returns as an undead avenging angel, reaping revenge on the Ravensbrück family and her manically possessive brother.

programme.title: Mrs Aylwood Won't Die
programme.desc: Winter 1969. In an isolated mansion, Susan Aylwood, a former glory of cinema, lives with her housekeeper, the discreet Caroline. Surrounded by her memories, Mrs Aylwood seems to keep a strong hand on her entourage. But what is the terrible truth behind the appearances ?

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: Game Show Dynamos
programme.desc: Bernard and Claire Boiko won enough money on TV game shows to escape debt and rebuild their lives, appearing on national television 28 times from the 1950s to the 1990s. Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents. Through love, hardship, ambition, and humor, the film captures a unique family story and a revealing slice of 20th-century life, culminating in Bernard's words: "If it's a lucky life, it's mine.

programme.title: Black Dragons
programme.desc: A cabal of American industrialists, all fifth-columnists intent on sabotaging the war effort, are methodically murdered by the malevolent Monsieur Colomb.

programme.title: Road Gate
programme.desc: Rauan works at a parking lot in a prestigious residential area. Aidar passes him daily in his luxurious car. The auto belongs to his father, who works in the oil business. Rauan and Aidar are both determined to build their own lives themselves. They live in the same city, their paths cross in the same yard, but there is an abyss between them. They are separated by a toll-bar between wealth and poverty. One day Aidar and Rauan will clash and their worlds will clash. What will the results be..?

programme.title: Revenge of the Zombies
programme.desc: When Dr. Von Altermann's wife Lila dies mysteriously at his spooky mansion her relations suspect murder. They also suspect the doctor is turning her into a zombie, to join the army of living dead he hopes to devote to the Nazi cause. However, Lila, though dead, has developed a will of her own.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Newly appointed sheriff Pat Garrett is pleased when his old friend Doc Holliday arrives in Lincoln, New Mexico on the stage. Doc is trailing his stolen horse, and it is discovered in the possession of Billy the Kid. In a surprising turnaround, Billy and Doc become friends. This causes the friendship between Doc and Pat to cool. The odd relationship between Doc and Billy grows stranger when Doc hides Billy at his girl Rio's place after Billy is shot.

programme.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
programme.desc: Swordsman-poet helps soldier woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: Australia
programme.desc: Friday, 11:00 p.m. Carla, a woman of about forty, is alone in her office. She gets a call, it's Raúl, a young guy who passes her cocaine. They've known each other for some years, but they've never exchanged more than two consecutive sentences. Tonight will be the last night that Raúl works as a dealer. He wants to change his life. He's going to Australia, to work as a gardener.

programme.title: The Terror of Tiny Town
programme.desc: Using a conventional Western story with an all dwarf cast, the filmmakers were able to showcase gags such as cowboys entering the local saloon by walking under the swinging doors, and pint-sized cowboys galloping around on Shetland ponies while roping calves.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dance
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Hippos are terrifying animals in their own right, but they also have enough meat on them to be tempting prey. A pride of 16 lions surround one, but its jaws can crush a skull with one bite _ who will triumph?

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: On East Africa's plains, millions of wildebeest and zebras migrate, crossing the Mara and Grumeti rivers where crocodiles lie in wait. DC, a dominant croc, faces challenges at each hunting zone—from shallow waters to rocky crossings. He battles rivals, adapts his strategy, and learns to thrive in changing conditions. As the rivers dry and herds thin, DC makes one final kill. The Mara and Grumeti demand unique skills, turning quiet waters into deadly Predator Zones.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Desert creatures endure searing heat and zero rainfall, but speed is their ticket to survival.A Tiger beetle runs at the human equivalent of 500 miles per hour. A caracal jumps six feet to swat a weaverbird out of midair. And the world's fastest chameleon hunts on the desert floor.Only the hardiest, fastest animals survive. Nothing else stands a chance.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You'll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it's prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia's Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.desc: And we're off! We learn the history of the world famous Kentucky Derby. Then, call your shot as we learn about one of America's most famous brands, Louisville Slugger. Also, we zip line in the world's only underground zip line attraction and visit the Ali Center.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: The Saints come marching in as we tour the iconic St. Louis Cathedral and the mysterious Ursuline Convent in New Orleans. We delve into Mardi Gras history at Mardi Gras World and visit the National WWII Museum's world class collection.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Annual brood stock fishery from Percy Walkus Hatchery in Wuikinuxv, Rivers Inlet...conserving the largest Chinook on Earth!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Agra is home to India's most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. First, we tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal's construction. Bill takes us to a factory where we learn how the craft of stone inlay that adorns the Taj Mahal, is still made today. We continue on to Fatehpur Sikri, a former Mughal capital, which was created of red sandstone and displays the influence of its Hindu and Mughal roots. Finally, we meet with a man that is giving the wildlife of India a voice and sanctuary.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the most sacred places in India are featured in this fascinating episode. Bill first burst the myths surrounding the legendary Khajuraho and its intricately carved temples before heading to the Holy City of Varanasi. Varanasi, the Jerusalem or Mecca for Hindus with its deep connection to the Ganges River, is explored with an insider's perspective.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World—all other great wilderness areas are compared to this vast savannah. Wildlife numbers are awesome, but nothing like the numbers of the great migration. Journeys places you in the midst of this natural phenomenon where predator and prey are on a march for survival.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Host Bill Ball begins the ascent of the highest mountain in Africa. Trouble almost immediately affects the team as the cameraman suffers from fatigue and altitude sickness. Just over halfway, the trip is in serious doubt as altitude, cold and wind force the team to evaluate their fitness to continue.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A world-class group of skiers explore epic backcountry terrain around Bralorne, B.C., areas accessible only by snowmobiles, with Canadian sled super-heroes as their guides.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Explore the windsurfing culture of Maui, and follow a Production Company as they make a Windsurfing movie. The serene island is the perfect backdrop for this sun, sea and surf extravaganza.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. They vary in size from grains of dust to mountain sides, footballs to planetoids. They were the building blocks of the planets and perhaps carry the origins of life itself. Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us new insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's the city of love, Paris, France. The world over knows its most famous structure, the Eiffel Tower! But did you know parisians originally wanted to tear it down! We'll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you'll visit America's first pizzeria! And how the gourmet ice cream Haagen Dazs got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how Sweet N Low actually got its name! And why do we yell shotgun when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the potato chip was invented out of anger!

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Quirky Science

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Earthquakes have always been with us, but only in recent decades has their devastating impact been captured so vividly on film and online. In this episode, we explore scenes from some of the most destructive natural cataclysms. Of all disasters, none releases more energy than an earthquake—caused when Earth's plates grind and snap, shaking hundreds of square miles. Most occur in the Pacific "Ring of Fire." Alaska sees a 7.0 quake yearly, while California experiences about 10,000, most too small to notice.

programme.title: RV Explorers

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world _ the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster _ North America's largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus _ Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider _ Hidden in messy webs, the female's scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web _ Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Wildebeest & Zebra _ Africa's iconic drifters. No two zebra have the same stripes, even in vast herds. Olive Ridley Turtles _ The world's most abundant sea turtle, migrating vast distances to nest. Sooty Tern _ These seabirds may stay airborne for years before returning to land to breed. Australian Pelicans _ Big-billed birds that follow inland waterways in search of fish. Whales & Whale Sharks _ Ocean giants that roam the seas, some on epic migrations we barely understand. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus. You'll also witness the fascinating hunting technique of the cuttlefish.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

He helps tag sharks, study conch and investigate marine protected areas!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Jonathan travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach Jonathan how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility! Then, Jonathan heads to NASA's Neutral Buoyancy Lab in Houston, Texas (USA), where astronauts train for space walking underwater, in a giant pool about half the size of a soccer field. Jonathan gets a rare and fascinating look into this high-tech diving as he ventures underwater with the astronauts.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Humans have long dreamed of flight—from da Vinci's flapping-wing designs to massive cow-gut-filled airships. The Wright brothers, inspired by bicycles, built strong, controllable kites that led to early planes. Modern jets fly faster thanks to high-altitude, low-resistance flight, an idea sparked by Frank Whittle's Aeolipile experiments. From the Airbus A380 to NASA's scramjet, aviation keeps evolving—what's next in flight innovation?

Plus, find out how a melting chocolate bar gave way to the invention of the microwave!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It was the purrrfect idea for making our furry friends more pleasant around the house! You'll learn how litty litter clawed its way into our homes. And finally, we'll "cut to the chase" and explain the history behind this common phrase!

programme.desc: New satellites are being launched to continue detailed observations of Earth and its oceans an ice caps, They are finding that climate change is accelerating and they have the data to prove it.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: NASA'S Parker Solar Probe Mission is on its way and will be shortly followed by Europe's Solar probe Mission. No spacecraft have traveled so fast or so close to a star before. It is hoped to reveal the source of the solar winds that effect us here on Earth.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.desc: We live in a world full of the most magnificent of animals. There are approximately eight point seven (8.7) million different species on earth. With this vast array of natural wonders how do we choose a favorite amongst all these spectacular creatures? The ethereal grace of the oceans whales, the might of the imposing hippo, the unequalled speed of the cheetah, the mesmerizing lure of the snake, the power of the elephant, the strength of the ant, the stealth of the scorpion, the extraordinary talents of the octopus, the force of the crocodile, the sheer grace of the wedge tailed eagle, or the regular commanding presence of the lion...

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You'll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it's prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia's Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: In nature, both males and females fight fiercely—especially females defending their young. Most battles occur within the same species over food, territory, status, or mates. While not always fatal, these fights can lead to death. Animals protect food sources directly or by defending territory rich in prey. This territorial aggression helps distribute populations but can also limit them—like wolves starving without territory. Though fighting can secure survival, it comes at a cost: injury, exhaustion, and death. Often, avoiding conflict is the wisest strategy.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Prey must constantly avoid predators, and any defensive adaptation boosts survival. Speed is a key defense—antelope are built to run, chased by sprinters like cheetahs. Over time, predators evolved to be fast, and prey evolved to be faster. Antelope also travel long distances for food. Ostriches, though flightless, are the fastest-running birds. The Golden Wheel spider escapes danger by turning into a rolling wheel. In the Race of Life, survival depends on clever, sometimes surprising adaptations.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world's largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Edison didn't invent the light bulb—he made it practical. Early lighting included unsafe limelight and blinding arc lamps. Edison tested thousands of filaments, even a beard hair, to improve bulb life. Others explored gas-based bulbs, leading to energy-saving lamps. Lasers, once Einstein's theory, became essential tech. Today, lighting innovations include invisible wavelengths and even laser therapy. What's next in the evolution of light?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Alexander Graham Bell, inspired by a misunderstood German paper, aimed to send multiple tones through a wire—leading to the invention of the telephone. He discovered that voice vibrations vary electric current strength, enabling sound transmission. Though revolutionary, it took time for people to grasp its impact. Today, wireless calls dominate, yet still rely on Bell's principles. As tech evolves, we may soon see phoneless communication.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's the city of love, Paris, France. The world over knows its most famous structure, the Eiffel Tower! But did you know parisians originally wanted to tear it down! We'll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you'll visit America's first pizzeria! And how the gourmet ice cream Haagen Dazs got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how Sweet N Low actually got its name! And why do we yell shotgun when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the potato chip was invented out of anger!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. Paying customers will soon be launching into space; tourists and their money is thought to be a major step forward into space and beyond. Blue Origin flight tests have been a great success and may launch commercial flights as soon as year's end. Virgin Galactic is also smashing mile stones towards flight certification. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The ESA _ JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Malo ljudi zna da je Stojan zaljubljen u pecanje. On ima svoje omiljene riblje recepte i ova čorba jedna je od njih. Lora i Stojan spremiće poznati fugas hleb i govedinu iz tiganja sa pečurkama i pavlakom.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: U 4. sezoni serije "Pecite sa Akisom", voljeni grčki kuvar Akis vraća se sa toplim i primamljivim receptima u kojima spaja grčko kulinarsko nasleđe sa međunarodnom inspiracijom, nudeći jednostavne tehnike i ukusne rezultate za kuvare svih nivoa.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Džejmi sprema testo sa brokolijem i tikvicom i salatu od paradajza sa pršutom i salatom od bundeve.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Sve za 30 minuta
programme.desc: Danas Džejmi sprema dimljeni losos sa salatom od krompira,cveklom i domaćim sirom sa ražanim hlebom i domaćim puterom.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, spremaće se ukusna svinjska rebarca na azijski način, sa pireom od peršuna. Lora i Stojan spremaju i ukusno predjelo sa suvim crvenim paprikama. Za dezert spremaju slatku danitsu na arapski način.

programme.title: Dejvid Roko: Domaći slatkiši
programme.desc: Poslednjih godina, mnogi su prestali da putuju, pa i Dejvid Roko. Njega i porodicu su hrana i kuvanje zbližili. Dejvid sada otvara svoj dom i poziva porodicu i prijatelje da podele svoju priču o tome šta hrana znači za njih.

programme.title: Nadijini brzi ukusi
programme.desc: Nadija je u misiji da vrati uzbuđenje u svakodnevne obroke, sa mnogo novih načina da se poboljša ukus hrane. Pritom, ona ne poštuje pravila, jer je tako zabavno praviti neobične kombinacije ukusa! U ovim epizodama nijedan ukus neće ostati neistražen!

programme.title: Nadijini brzi ukusi
programme.desc: Nadija je u misiji da vrati uzbuđenje u svakodnevne obroke, sa mnogo novih načina da se poboljša ukus hrane. Pritom, ona ne poštuje pravila, jer je tako zabavno praviti neobične kombinacije ukusa! U ovim epizodama nijedan ukus neće ostati neistražen!

programme.title: Mišel Ru na reci: Temza
programme.desc: Mišel Ru plovi veličanstvenom Temzom i staje uzduž obala da bi uživao u hrani, kuvarima, meštanima i istoriji, koristeći sve to kao nadahnuće. Kao Temza, hrana se razvija na putu ka moru. Na brodu, Mišel će kuvati jela inspirisana onim što je sreo.

programme.title: Markus Vering: Priče iz kulinarske bašte
programme.desc: Markus Vering istražuje nove mogućnosti na svom imanju u Saseksu. Markus upoznaje različite vrste paradajza i unosi promene koje će mu pomoći da zaštiti patke od napada lisica.

programme.title: Gurmanski voz: Džonatan Pang
programme.desc: U drugom delu avanture u Severnoj Americi, Džonatan se vozi "Kanađaninom", napušta Stenovite planine i kreće prema ogromnim prostranstvima prerija. Međutim, pre putovanja, Džonatan postaje motociklista u dolini medveda i sprema palačinke od konoplje.

programme.title: Džejmi i Džimi u gastronomskom izazovu
programme.desc: Džejmi i Džimi započinju Novu godinu sa prvim, isključivo veganskim menijem. U avanturama u kafeu pridružuje im se komičar Romeš Randžanatan. Džejmi i Džimi kreću u pohod da dokažu da veganska kuhinja može biti ukusna. Meso vam neće nedostajati.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: Kuvar Akis Petretzikis vraća se sa 10 živopisnih epizoda mediteranskih gozbi i neodoljivih deserta. Od porodičnih pečenja do rashlađenih kolača i grčkih klasika, 5. sezona donosi jednostavne, ukusne recepte za svakodnevne obroke i posebna okupljanja.

programme.title: Najdžel Slejter: Bliski istok
programme.desc: Najdžel počinje svoju avanturu u Bejrutu, na kraju Ramazana, gde proslavlja Bajram sa lokalnom porodicom. Zatim putuje na jug do Nabatije i istočno do doline Beka.

programme.title: Đino Kuva Ljubav
programme.desc: Mnogima je put do srca kroz stomak. Naš kuvar zove po troje usamljenih studenata da nađu ljubav kuvajući. Sem što "kuvaju ljubav", oni će ići i na prelepe izlete. Vrhunac serije je u "Poslednjoj Gozbi", gde saznajemo: može li se ljubav naći u hrani?

programme.title: Džejmi: Sve za 20 minuta
programme.desc: Svako jelo u ovoj seriji snimljeno je u jednom kadru bez montaže, bez trikova, odvažni recepti u realnom vremenu u jednom neprekinutom kadru. Brza hrana u realnom vremenu, večera za 20 minuta ili manje tako da publika zaista može da poveruje.

programme.title: Donalovi brzi superobroci

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan pokazaće nam da je pravljenje ukusnih hlebnih štapića kod kuće prilično jednostavno. Zatim će pokazati recept za ukusno glavno jelo, omlet sa mlevenim mesom.Takođe će spremiti sladoled kocke od manga i jogurta.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Salata od piletine i škampa koju spremaju Lora i Stojan zanimljiva je i ukusna. Dvojac će potom preobratiti italijansku palentu u krostinije i servirati ih sa pečenim paprikama i sirom. Za desert spremaju kapkejkove od šargarepe i jabuke.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Salata od zelenog pasulja i spanaća, koju će nam pokazati Lora i Stojan, može da bude i lagano glavno jelo. Kuvari će spremiti ukusnu musaku sa piletinom i krompir-njokama. Za kraj sledi prava kalorijska bomba, banica sa ratlukom.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan otkriće tajne za spremanje savršenog pilava. Njihov će biti sa vermičelima. Njihov orijentalni meni nastavlja se sa jagnjećom kolenicom, koju će servirati sa semenkama nara i orasima. Za desert spremaju indijski sladoled sa šafranom.

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvajte kao profesionalac
programme.desc: Nagrađivani kuvar Mark poziva gledaoce da preispitaju način na koji kuvaju kod kuće. Zaboravite na ideju da odlična hrana zahteva beskrajne sastojke ili sate u kuhinji. Mark pokazuje da svako može da napravi jela dostojna restorana u svojoj kuhinji.

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvar van dužnosti vraća se kući
programme.desc: Bivši svetski mladi kuvar godine slavi irske korene svojih voljenih recepata. Kuvar van dužnosti odlazi do kuće svojih roditelja u Vest Keriju, gde istražuje priobalno i seosko okruženje koje je inspirisalo neka od njegovih omiljenih jela.

programme.title: Mišel Ru na reci: Temza
programme.desc: Isplovite opet sa kuvarom Mišelom Ruom dok crta kulinarsku mapu, prateći tok Temze. Od Batersija preko Griniča i Vindzora do Redinga, Mišel je ucrtao kurs za još jedan niz izvrsnih i ukusnih kuvarskih vratolomija.

programme.title: Gurmanski voz: Džonatan Pang
programme.desc: U Sidneju Džonatan preleće hidroavionom iznad prelepog Palm Springsa. Na zemlji, novinar uživa u opuštajućem životu na plaži i isprobava ukusan čileanski brancin u svetski poznatom restoranu "Kod Džona". Zatim posećuje restoran Majka Džonatana.

programme.title: Džejmi u Gruziji
programme.desc: Džejmi vas vodi na kulinarsko putovanje kroz Gruziju na raskrsnici Istoka i Zapada, istražujući pijace Tbilisija i živopisnu vinsku regiju Kahetija. Nakon što uči od lokalnih kuvara, on uživa u tradicionalnim jelima i u gozbi, a zatim kod kuće pravi pečenje nadahnuto viđenim.

programme.title: Donalovi brzi superobroci
programme.desc: Donal Skijan će nam pokazati kako da spremimo ukusne obroke koji štede vreme. U ovoj epizodi Donal pravi piletinu sa parmezanom, koja se sprema u samo jednoj šerpi. Zatim sprema nudle sa svinjetinom i riblji paprikaš sa pasuljem.

programme.title: Donalovi brzi superobroci
programme.desc: Donal Skijan sprema brze obroke koji će zadovoljiti čitavu porodicu. Za početak, Donal pravi ukusnu piletinu na tajlandski način, koja je bogata aromom. Zatim slede hrskavi losos i ukusne špargle u sosu od čeri paradajza i bosiljka.
